claims.statement: IEA PVPS reports that EU PV waste is regulated under WEEE and that current PV recycling faces low volumes, logistics challenges, limited technologies, and a high-cost, low-revenue situation even as future volumes rise.
EU law places financing responsibility for collection, treatment, recovery, and environmentally sound disposal of in-scope PV waste on producers under specified placement dates and schemes.
Pooling fragmented batches may solve the logistics portion of the bottleneck before dedicated high-value recycling is economical, but Polish route density is unknown.

contrary_evidence: The same IEA PVPS evidence says present volumes are low and economics are high-cost and low-revenue.
Producer responsibility organizations and existing waste carriers may already bundle pickup at little direct cost to holders.
Damaged modules, fire contamination, reuse testing, and cross-border shipments can add safety and waste-permit complexity.

economics.acquisition_route: Insert a pickup-and-certificate step into installer decommissioning checklists and insurer claim closure: a case cannot close until the serial manifest and destination certificate are uploaded. Publish fixed route dates by region so small holders can book spare pallet capacity online.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Route density, reusable rack circulation, compliant carrier and recycler contracts, standardized manifests, and tested resale/offtake channels jointly improve unit economics. The operational network and guaranteed handoff are the advantage, not a database of retired panels.
fingerprint.customer: Solar installers, insurers, commercial PV owners, demolition firms, and producer-compliance schemes that accumulate damaged, warranty-returned, or repowered modules below economical full-load quantities.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Insert a pickup-and-certificate step into installer decommissioning checklists and insurer claim closure: a case cannot close until the serial manifest and destination certificate are uploaded. Publish fixed route dates by region so small holders can book spare pallet capacity online.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Aggregate small batches into scheduled milk runs, provide reusable transport racks, photograph and serialize modules, triage them into reuse/testing and licensed recycling streams, and return chain-of-custody certificates. Remain an orchestration and logistics layer initially rather than financing a recycling plant.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The waste holder, insurer, installer, or compliance scheme pays per module, pallet, or tonne when a documented pickup is completed; additional revenue comes from de-installation coordination and a share of independently tested reusable-module resale, where lawful.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Hail or fire claim closure, repowering, demolition, installer warehouse overflow, or a compliance audit creates a need for serial-level chain of custody, safe removal, triage, and lawful reuse or recycling.

founder_fit: Direct adjacency to the parents' renewable installation workflows supplies realistic process knowledge and a small validation stream.
Data and routing can be automated, while initial capital stays bounded by renting transport and using licensed recyclers.
Physical logistics and waste-law obligations make this less part-time-friendly unless pickups and warehousing are outsourced from day one.
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: Pooled Reverse Logistics for Retired Solar Modules
uncertainties: Annual tonnes available within economical Polish collection radii and who controls each batch.
Required permits and whether the venture can remain a broker without taking legal possession of waste.
Net value of tested reusable modules after warranty, testing, packing, and liability costs.
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Pre-sell one regional route and aggregate at least ten pallets from five independent holders before booking transport. Obtain written acceptance and pricing from a licensed recycler and reuse tester, then complete one documented run; stop if the contribution margin is negative without speculative resale value.
